annotations.title: Vendor Central payment estimates from POs

description: READ-ONLY. Vendor Central payment amounts estimated from purchase orders (Vendor accounts only). Amazon SP-API does not expose real remittances for reading, so figures are estimates computed from PO net cost. days_back = lookback window; summary_only = totals only.

account_id.description: ID dell'outpost Amazon (= un seller su uno specifico marketplace; vedi list_clients). Opzionale se il token è legato a un solo outpost.

days_back.description: Quanti giorni indietro partire da oggi (intero, es. 30).

name: get_vendor_remittances
